title: Opinion-claims results: add transparent claim-level drill-down
description:
As a reader, I want an opinion-claims results page that lets me inspect the exact statement, source basis, each model answer, and the limits of the measure, so that summary rates are not confused with a bias verdict.

Feature: opinion-claim result drill-down
  Scenario: reader opens a measured domain
    Given published claims and model records
    When the reader opens a domain or claim detail
    Then the page shows the verbatim question, source rationale, model answers, and whether a valid comparison exists

Public copy names the model as the subject and does not present political claims as facts.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented claim-level drill-down: fixed question, exact statements, source basis, per-model probabilities, and explicit comparison limits. Verified Python leaderboard/opinion tests and all 28 rendered-site tests.
